Celestron NexStar 8SE

The computerized 8-inch that finds it for you.

around $1,589

The classic 8-inch computerized Schmidt-Cassegrain. Type in a target — or just let the GoTo mount find it — and you're looking at Saturn's rings in minutes. If you want to check a light in the sky against a known satellite or star, this is the rig that makes it easy.
